decisions.rationale: It addresses transfer but understates the result: e5 beat every Model M variant on all four metrics, including the near-tied Recall@200.
It reports the absence of significance testing but omits sparse/incomplete judgments and the resulting unreliability of recall-based assessments.
It reports some mixed baseline comparisons but omits Model M-40M’s weakness, model-size dependence, Recall@200, and gte-modernbert-base’s failure.
It addresses the negative transfer finding but restricts e5’s superiority to MRR and NDCG, omitting both recall metrics and the Recall@200 near-tie.
It addresses failed transfer but omits Recall@200, where Model M-110M trailed e5 by only 0.001, overstating the unqualified non-generalization conclusion.
It portrays transfer only as uniform underperformance to e5, omitting the baseline-specific mixed recall pattern, size dependence, and gte-modernbert-base’s failure.
